title: A Client's Payment of a Fresh Subsidy Funding Lot into Its Micro Market
content:
A client of the Unattended Micro Market Program funding its micro market pays the fresh lot in itself. The money is recorded as cleared, the agreement's spendable subsidy funding grows by the amount paid in, and the posting carries the way the client paid and the period the lot is opened against.

## A condition on the size of the lot

The lot the client pays in is not fixed before a service credit naming no kiosk stands on the agreement, being the funding handed back to the client on a settlement. While no credit naming no kiosk stands on the agreement, the lot is not yet fixed.

## Paying the lot in

The tool `fund_market_subsidy_lot_f6d53aaa` records the funding. It is the customer's own tool: the desk unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it, one call adding a single subsidy funding posting to the agreement's ledger.

### Parameters

- `market_agreement_id` — the reference number identifying the micro market agreement being funded, as returned by the micro market agreement lookup.
- `service_period` — the settlement period the lot clears in, written as YYYY-MM with no other text. An empty value is not accepted.
- `payment_channel` — how the client is moving the money: `ach` where the client sends it by bank transfer out of their own accounts payable run; `check` where a paper cheque is being posted or handed over; `corporate_card` where a company card is being charged for it; `internal_transfer` where the money moves between ledgers inside a group that Larkspur Table bills centrally; `not_applicable` where the posting records funding in which no money actually moved.
- `funding_amount_usd` — the size of the lot being paid in, in USD to 2 decimal places, rounded to the nearest cent at the point of booking, a figure falling exactly on the half-cent going to the nearest even cent. A negative value is not accepted.

### Return

A single confirmation sentence in plain text, carrying the reference number minted for the new funding posting, the settlement period the lot was opened against, and the amount funded in USD to two decimal places. Receiving that sentence means the lot is on the agreement and drawable; no other outcome is reported.

## The effect on the client's account

Afterwards the client sees the lot among the agreement's postings, and employees shopping at the kiosk can be discounted out of it.
